editor.fontFamily: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
scm.inputFontFamily: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font', 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
terminal.integrated.fontFamily: 'JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

code-runner.executorMap.java: clear && cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && javac -d output $fileName && java -cp output $fileNameWithoutExt
code-runner.executorMap.c: clear && cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gcc $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.cpp: clear && cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && g++ $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.objective-c: clear && cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gcc -framework Cocoa $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.go: clear && cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && go build -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe $fileName && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.rust: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && rustc $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.pascal: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && fpc -FEoutput $fileName && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.d: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && dmd -od=output -of=output/$fileNameWithoutExt $fileName && clear && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.less: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && lessc $fileName output/$fileNameWithoutExt.css
code-runner.executorMap.FortranFreeForm: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gfortran $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.fortran-modern: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gfortran $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.fortran_fixed-form: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gfortran $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.fortran: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && gfortran $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt && clear && ./output/$fileNameWithoutExt.exe
code-runner.executorMap.pkl: cd $dir && mkdir output -Force | Out-Null && pkl eval -f yaml $fileName -o output/$fileNameWithoutExt.yaml
